tagline: Clinical trial monolith on Java EE + WebLogic + Oracle 11g

profile.name: TrialHub CTMS
profile.business_function: Clinical Trial Management System for study planning, site management, subject enrolment tracking and monitoring visits
profile.description: In-house Java EE monolith built in 2011. Manages ~120 active studies, investigator sites, enrolment milestones and monitoring visit reports. Supports inspection readiness for FDA/EMA audits.
profile.tech_stack: Java 7, EJB 3.0, JSF 1.2 + RichFaces, Hibernate 3, Apache Ant build, deployed as a single EAR (~180k lines of code)
profile.database: Oracle Database 11g R2 Enterprise, ~1.2 TB, heavy use of PL/SQL packages and Oracle-specific SQL
profile.hosting: On-premises Oracle WebLogic 10.3.6 cluster (4 nodes) on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6
profile.integrations: EDC system (SOAP web services), IRT/randomisation vendor (SFTP files), safety database (nightly batch ETL via Quartz jobs), SharePoint for TMF documents, LDAP authentication
profile.users: ~1,800 users: clinical operations staff, CRAs and site users in 25 countries
profile.data_classification: GCP records with pseudonymised subject data (GDPR special category data); 21 CFR Part 11 audit trails; 25-year retention for trial master file records
profile.pain_points: Release cycle is 6 months because the full EAR must be revalidated; WebLogic licence costs; Oracle 11g unsupported; Java 7 security findings; poor performance for sites in APAC
profile.constraints: Subject data for EU sites must stay in the EU; inspection-ready audit trail must be preserved through migration; 2 studies in database lock during Q1
